title: Data Analyst
summary: Turns business, product, or operational data into clear findings and decisions.
activities: Clean datasets, query databases, build dashboards, explain trends, and work with stakeholders.

roadmap.goal: Build confidence querying and cleaning data.
roadmap.activity: Analyze a public dataset with SQL or spreadsheets; write a short data dictionary.

roadmap.goal: Practice a complete analysis and communicate its limits.
roadmap.activity: Create a reproducible notebook and dashboard with a concise findings note.

roadmap.goal: Prepare evidence for interviews and applications.
roadmap.activity: Review analyst job descriptions in your region, map evidence to requirements, and practice explaining trade-offs.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
summary: Builds and maintains software systems that use machine learning models in products.
activities: Prepare data pipelines, train or integrate models, test services, monitor model behavior, and collaborate with product teams.

roadmap.goal: Strengthen Python, software testing, and core statistics.
roadmap.activity: Build a small tested data-processing package and document assumptions.

roadmap.goal: Train and evaluate a baseline model using a documented public dataset.
roadmap.activity: Compare to a simple baseline; record data provenance, metrics, and failure cases.

roadmap.goal: Understand the path from experiment to maintainable service.
roadmap.activity: Wrap a model in an API, add input validation, and write monitoring considerations.

title: UX Researcher
summary: Studies user needs and behavior to help teams design more useful and accessible experiences.
activities: Plan interviews or usability studies, synthesize evidence, communicate findings, and partner with designers and engineers.

roadmap.goal: Learn ethical study design and foundational research methods.
roadmap.activity: Draft a research plan with consent, recruitment, and bias considerations.

roadmap.goal: Run a small usability study with appropriate consent.
roadmap.activity: Synthesize observations into themes, evidence, and open questions.

roadmap.goal: Show how research changed a design decision.
roadmap.activity: Create a case study that distinguishes participant evidence from your interpretation.

title: Product Manager
summary: Connects user problems, business goals, and delivery teams to shape product direction.
activities: Research needs, define outcomes, prioritize work, coordinate delivery, and evaluate product results.

roadmap.goal: Practice framing a user problem and measurable outcome.
roadmap.activity: Write a one-page problem brief separating evidence, assumptions, and risks.

roadmap.goal: Learn lightweight research and prioritization.
roadmap.activity: Interview users with consent and synthesize needs without pitching a solution.

roadmap.goal: Demonstrate decisions and trade-offs.
roadmap.activity: Prepare a product case study including success measures and what you would test next.

title: Cybersecurity Analyst
summary: Helps organizations reduce security risks and investigate suspicious activity.
activities: Review alerts, analyze logs, support incident response, document controls, and improve security practices.

roadmap.goal: Understand networking, operating systems, and basic threat concepts.
roadmap.activity: Build a home lab using intentionally vulnerable training environments only.

roadmap.goal: Practice log review and incident documentation.
roadmap.activity: Analyze a public sample log dataset and write a cautious incident timeline.

roadmap.goal: Develop safe, ethical professional habits.
roadmap.activity: Study entry-level role requirements and practice clear, evidence-based incident reports.

title: Business Intelligence Analyst
summary: Designs reporting and data models that help teams monitor business performance.
activities: Gather reporting needs, define metrics, model data, build dashboards, and maintain trustworthy reporting.

roadmap.goal: Learn to define metrics with clear meaning and caveats.
roadmap.activity: Create a metric glossary and identify possible misleading interpretations.

roadmap.goal: Build a dashboard from a documented dataset.
roadmap.activity: Use SQL and a visualization tool; include data freshness and limitations.

roadmap.goal: Explain insights to a non-technical audience.
roadmap.activity: Present a short narrative that connects findings to a decision and next step.

title: Digital Marketing Analyst
summary: Uses campaign and audience data to improve digital communications and marketing decisions.
activities: Measure campaigns, analyze audience behavior, run experiments, and share actionable recommendations.

roadmap.goal: Understand channel metrics and attribution limits.
roadmap.activity: Create a measurement plan that distinguishes clicks, engagement, and business outcomes.

roadmap.goal: Practice a modest, ethical campaign analysis.
roadmap.activity: Analyze a public or permissioned dataset and note confounders and privacy choices.

roadmap.goal: Communicate recommendations clearly.
roadmap.activity: Show an analysis with audience context, uncertainty, and practical next steps.

title: Research Associate
summary: Supports structured research projects by collecting, analyzing, and communicating evidence.
activities: Review literature, manage data, apply research methods, document procedures, and prepare findings.

roadmap.goal: Refresh methods relevant to your subject area.
roadmap.activity: Critique a published study's question, methods, evidence, and limitations.

roadmap.goal: Demonstrate careful documentation.
roadmap.activity: Reproduce a small analysis from public data with a transparent workflow.

roadmap.goal: Match your methods experience to role requirements.
roadmap.activity: Prepare examples of research decisions, collaboration, and ethical practice.

title: Technical Writer
summary: Makes complex products and processes easier to understand through clear documentation.
activities: Interview subject experts, structure content, write and edit guides, and improve documentation using feedback.

roadmap.goal: Practice turning a task into a clear information flow.
roadmap.activity: Rewrite a public technical procedure for a defined audience and test it with a reader.

roadmap.goal: Build a small, coherent documentation set.
roadmap.activity: Create a tutorial, reference page, and troubleshooting guide for a simple project.

roadmap.goal: Improve accuracy and usability through review.
roadmap.activity: Ask a subject expert to verify technical details and readers to test task completion.

title: People Analytics Associate
summary: Uses workforce information to help organizations understand employee experience and people processes.
activities: Prepare workforce data, define careful metrics, analyze patterns, and communicate privacy-conscious findings.

roadmap.goal: Learn basic workforce metrics and privacy principles.
roadmap.activity: Review a sample metric and identify small-group privacy and interpretation risks.

roadmap.goal: Explore a public workforce dataset responsibly.
roadmap.activity: Document data limits and avoid unsupported causal conclusions.

roadmap.goal: Present an actionable, careful people insight.
roadmap.activity: Create an anonymized case study centered on decisions and safeguards.
